// diagnostic

E0201

The move marker `^` is required; value can't be copied

What

The move marker `^` is required; value can't be copied

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Add the move marker `^` at the consuming call site.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0201: tests/ui/close_value_stored_then_used.stderr.

Error [E0121]: `a.id` was consumed by the struct literal, so it can't be used here
  --> close_value_stored_then_used.jet:22:13
    |
 22 |     print(a.id)
    |             ^^
  --> close_value_stored_then_used.jet:21:23
    |
 21 |     h :: Holder{item: a}
    |                       ^ `a.id` moved to the struct literal here
 Why: After a value moves somewhere else, its old name no longer gives access to it
 Fix: Stop using `a.id` after the move, or give the struct literal a copy with `a.id.copy()` where it moved.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0121

Error [E0201]: `r` cannot be moved from borrowed storage
  --> close_value_stored_then_used.jet:49:18
    |
 49 |     Holder{item: r}
    |                  ^
 Why: `r` is a read or write parameter, so its caller keeps the value, and `Res` can't be copied into the struct literal
 Fix: Declare the parameter `^` so the caller hands the value over
